title: Disability Compensation Payable During Felony Incarceration: Rate Schedule
content:
When a veteran is incarcerated for a felony, Disability Compensation is limited to the incarcerated monthly rate from day 61 of continuous incarceration, day 1 being the first day of incarceration. The incarcerated rate is the 10 percent rate, or half of it for an award at the 10 percent rating. Full benefits are restored from the release date when VA is notified within 365 calendar days after the release.

| Tier | Incarcerated monthly rate (USD) | Reduced rate applies from day of continuous felony incarceration | Notice window after release (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Disability Compensation (10% Combined Rating) | 90.21 | 61 | 365 |
| Disability Compensation (20% Combined Rating) | 180.42 | 61 | 365 |
| Disability Compensation (30% Combined Rating) | 180.42 | 61 | 365 |
| Disability Compensation (40% Combined Rating) | 180.42 | 61 | 365 |
| Disability Compensation (50% Combined Rating) | 180.42 | 61 | 365 |
| Disability Compensation (60% Combined Rating) | 180.42 | 61 | 365 |
| Disability Compensation (70% Combined Rating) | 180.42 | 61 | 365 |
| Disability Compensation (80% Combined Rating) | 180.42 | 61 | 365 |
| Disability Compensation (90% Combined Rating) | 180.42 | 61 | 365 |
| Disability Compensation (100% Combined Rating) | 180.42 | 61 | 365 |

**Counting the days (hypothetical illustration).** For felony incarceration beginning on 1 March, day 1 is 1 March and day 61 is 30 April; the incarcerated rate applies from 30 April. Incarceration that ends on day 60, 29 April, ends before the reduction start day.
